label: ENTERTAINMENT
title: Kelly Clarkson vs. a Brooklyn Shop: The $15,000 Bird Now Priced at $15 Million
image_files: File:Kelly Clarkson 2018 DoD Warrior Games Opening Ceremony 11.jpg
paragraphs: Kelly Clarkson walked into a Brooklyn shop to buy a bird. Now that bird is priced at fifteen million dollars.
The shop is Art of Play, a curiosity store in Brooklyn Heights. She wanted Molly, a mechanical bird that sings.
Clarkson says staff looked at her as if she couldn't afford it. She posted a fifteen thousand dollar price tag and said the shop just lost a huge sale.
The store says Molly was never for sale. It says the tag was for a near-identical bird by its maker, and staff offered her a two thousand dollar one.
Security footage shows her inside for about five minutes, but it has no sound, so it doesn't settle who is right. Clarkson's reply: you're not only rude, you're also a liar.
Now a new sign prices Molly at fifteen million dollars. The co-owner says the feud brought threats to the shop. Whose side are you on?
